comment: Claude Routine trigger IDs for this engine. Runs may retune schedules/prompts via update_trigger (ENGINE.md §6). Cron is UTC; Bucharest is UTC+3 in summer, UTC+2 in winter.
known_issue: Triggers created 2026-08-02 could not store MCP connectors (org limitation). If a fired session lacks mcp__BT_Trade__* tools (check via ToolSearch at run start), do not trade; journal it, alert the owner via Telegram, and ask the owner to recreate the routines from the claude.ai Routines UI with the BT Trade connector attached.
